suite: r1107 explicit storage snapshot health presenter
method: The shipped presenter runs in a Node VM against a controlled parsed DOM and real EventTarget callbacks. The core is a deferred observer contract: tests drive resolve/reject and cancellation order and inspect rendered text and ownership. No production functions are copied into the test.
limitations: No browser engine, native disclosure interaction, accessibility tree, geometry, computed styles or screenshot pixels were exercised.
The storage core is a controlled deferred boundary here; IndexedDB traversal and archive access are validated by the separate storage core suite.
